# Aunt Jamesina

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Jimsie  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P47](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0047), [v3 ch.Interlude P41](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0041), [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P0](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman with a softly-triangular face, pink cheeks, and large, soft blue eyes full of youthful hope. Her snow-white hair is styled in quaint little puffs over her ears.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is a sweet, old-fashioned woman who admits that both her clothes and opinions reflect her traditional ways. Known for her mirthful eyes and proper respect for the clergy, she harbors a dislike for visiting others because of the trouble involved in opening her own house. Though she holds a low opinion of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), she compensates by loving her deeply.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Speaks P10](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0010), [v3 ch.Jonas P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042)_

## History

Though she never attended college herself, Aunt Jamesina moved into Patty's Place to act as housekeeper for her niece [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). She brought along her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat, and quickly established a warm, relaxed household routine with the girls. Over their years together, Aunt Jamesina regularly shared conversation, advice, and stories of her own youth and past suitors with the household as the young women navigated their studies and romances. She remained a comforting presence at Patty's Place through their graduations up until the friends packed up the house at the end of their college life.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P3](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0003), [v3 ch.Friend P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Friend P15](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0015), [v3 ch.Friend P16](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0016), [v3 ch.Friend P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), +332 more_

## Quotes

> "She couldn’t take Joseph with her so she begged me to take him. I really couldn’t refuse. He’s a beautiful cat—that is, his disposition is beautiful. She called him Joseph because his coat is of many colors."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)

> "Kittens have to be drowned, I admit, or the world would be overrun. But no decent, grown-up cat should be done to death—unless he sucks eggs."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)

> "Well, I hope so, Anne. I do hope so, because I love her. But I can’t understand her—she beats me. She isn’t like any of the girls I ever knew, or any of the girls I was myself."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Yes, in my soul. But I’ll admit my legs aren’t as young as yours. You go and get some fresh air, Anne. You look pale lately."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

> "Anybody is liable to rheumatism in her legs, Anne. It’s only old people who should have rheumatism in their souls, though. Thank goodness, I never have. When you get rheumatism in your soul you might as well go and pick out your coffin."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) lives with Aunt Jamesina at Patty's Place, where the two share a fond and affectionate household bond. They frequently spend time chatting comfortably alongside the other girls about domestic life, winter weather, and Phil's whimsical personality. Aunt Jamesina takes a keen interest in Phil's romantic life, listening to her display her dresses before dances and discussing her various suitors.

- Friend of — loves and lives with her  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)</sub>
